"'''The Ganguls / Bad Eggs'''" is the eleventh episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="More YJA Episodes" />

==Official description==
''Nash's Jedi friends set out to find her missing speeder. Hap's kitchen is overrun by creatures.''
